tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Santa Wishlist gift inspiration. Returns ok, storage, paapi, trackingTag, defaultDomain, catalogCount, and marketplaces[] (domain, label, tagConfigured). amazon.se (default) and amazon.com (US) are the primary storefronts. OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (domain, label, currencyHint, tagConfigured). Same data as get_health.marketplaces. Pass the user's marketplace (amazon.com for US, amazon.se for Sweden) on search/catalog/resolve/create.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search kids Christmas gift ideas for the user's store (amazon.com for US, amazon.se default). Returns kids-filtered search link cards + curated catalogMatches (English on amazon.com). q is optional. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Paginated hand-picked kids gift catalog (~600 on amazon.se, ~560 English items on amazon.com). amazon.se: /dp product links with SEK price hints. amazon.com: English names, tagged amazon.com search links, no SEK prices (catalogMode search-ideas). OpenAPI: getCatalog.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl for the user's store (amazon.com or amazon.se). Curated catalog ASINs on amazon.com become English search links. With no input it returns a default kids gift search. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a kids Christmas wishlist. Pass marketplace (amazon.com for US, amazon.se default) so buy links match the shopper's store. Returns id, editToken, shopUrl, ownerUrl, parentUrl, kidUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. If storage is token, later mutations may return a ne

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated kids' Christmas gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call (or give only ageBand/interests to auto-fill curated picks). Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Fetch a wishlist by id. Returns items with buyUrl/linkType for the list's store (override with marketplace), plus shopUrl, parentUrl and kidUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_wishlist_item
tools.description: Add an item to a wishlist. Requires editToken from create. Body: name/title plus asin, url (pasted /dp), searchKeywords, or catalogId. Token storage may return a new id — update bookmarks. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_product · Private data: create_wishlist, add_wishlist_item · Public sink: create_and_fill.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_product · Private data: create_wishlist, add_wishlist_item · Public sink: create_and_fill

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
